pages.text: Two optional fluids make an engine cheaper to run. Each one cuts fuel consumption to $(item)70%$(), and with both the engine burns about half the fuel.$(br2)$(li)$(item)Lubrication Oil$()$(li)$(item)Cooling Fluid$()

Each is stored separately in the engine, up to $(item)2000 mB$(). Right-click the engine with a $(item)bucket$() to add 1000 mB (refused while it already holds more than 1000), or use the refillable items:

$(li)$(item)Oil Can$() for lubrication oil, $(item)Cooling Fluid Bottle$() for cooling fluid. Each holds 4000 mB. Right-click a tank, a vat or any fluid container to fill it; sneak-right-click a container to pour it back.

$(li)Right-click the engine with the full item to top the engine up to 2000 mB.$(br2)A running engine uses both fluids up slowly. The goggles show $(item)Oil$() and $(item)Cooling Fluid$() while any is left.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
